# Everything integration

Official IPC header from https://www.voidtools.com/Everything-SDK.zip, downloaded 2026-09-06. Kalwer uses the supported asynchronous WM_COPYDATA protocol directly with bounded waits.

Historical v0.5.0 installer (no longer embedded or executed by Kalwer): https://www.voidtools.com/Everything-1.4.1.1032.x64-Setup.exe
SHA-256 c42efad041d4c0bb4d4ac97ae7cbe89f153ec1fe078772392e749c7f5d5282d3, verified against https://www.voidtools.com/Everything-1.4.1.1032.sha256.

Since v0.5.1, /index-setup opens the official download page in the user's browser. Existing Everything installations are reused. License.txt contains the historical upstream distribution notices; SDK source is MIT licensed by David Carpenter (2022).
